models.label: Qwen3.8-27B
notes: Same model class as Qwen3.5 (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration); builds on Qwen3.6-27B.

lineage.name: Qwen2.5-VL
lineage.change: Window-attention ViT (patch 14), MRoPE aligned to absolute time; SFT + DPO post-training.

lineage.name: Qwen3-VL
lineage.change: SigLIP-2 ViT (patch 16), DeepStack (multi-level ViT features added to LLM layers 0-2), interleaved MRoPE, text timestamps for video; SAPO RL.

lineage.name: Qwen3.5
lineage.change: Early-fusion native multimodal; hybrid 3:1 Gated DeltaNet / gated attention; DeepStack removed; vocab 248K; MTP; one hybrid thinking model.

lineage.name: Qwen3.6
lineage.change: 27B dense & 35B-A3B on the same architecture; thinking preservation introduced.

lineage.name: Qwen3.8
lineage.change: 27B dense VLM on the Qwen3.5 architecture; reasoning_effort levels; preserve_thinking on by default.

lineage.name: Out of scope (>100B)
lineage.change: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B / 397B-A17B, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B-A6B, new QSA / Gated Residual / n-gram design), Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B.
